name: CallForMe
description: Gives your AI agent a phone. It calls businesses in the US and Canada, works the phone menu, waits on hold, asks your agent mid-call when the business needs something, and returns the answers plus a transcript.

auth.instructions: Connect over OAuth in your browser. The server supports Dynamic Client Registration and creates an account on connect, so nothing needs to be entered. Pay per call: $1 per answered call including the first 2 minutes; a demo line works with no credit.
